title: The Effects of Sound Energy on Pulmonary Gas Exchange
brief_summary: Study of the effects of sonic pressure oscillations on pulmonary gas exchange with added dead space.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy male or female volunteers in the age group.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any acute or chronic cardiopulmonary disorder including a simple common cold.
study_population: Young healthy adults of any gender.
